extracted.intended_audience: poets and creative writers seeking a short residency/workshop program
extracted.subtask_description: A short residential poetry program where participants write new poems daily, read those poems in peer sessions, and work in workshops with staff poets alongside craft discussions; includes tuition and limited scholarships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Founding belief: community writing fosters stronger work
rubrics_metrics.description: The Poetry Program is founded on the belief that when poets gather in a community to write new poems, each poet may break through old habits and write something stronger and truer than before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the program's guiding principle: communal, sustained writing and peer interaction are expected to produce substantive breakthroughs in craft and truthfulness of poems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Produce new poems (daily output expectation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each participant is expected to write new poems while in the program; mornings are devoted to reading the work of the previous twenty-four hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program structure assumes daily composition — participants prepare and share new work each morning (work from the previous 24 hours), so regular, short-interval writing is an implicit requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop with staff poets (multiple feedback opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each participant has an opportunity to work with each staff poet in workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should be prepared to receive and respond to feedback from multiple staff poets across the session; the opportunity to meet with every staff poet is a core feature and expectation of participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily peer readings
rubrics_metrics.description: In the mornings participants meet to read to each other the work of the previous twenty-four hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer reading sessions are a regular, structured part of the program; active participation in morning readings is expected as part of the collaborative workshop environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft conversations
rubrics_metrics.description: In the late afternoons they gather for a conversation about some aspect of craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Afternoon sessions focus on specific craft topics; participants should engage in discussions intended to deepen technical and aesthetic understanding of poetry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition and included services
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition for the Poetry Program is $675, which includes photocopying and evening meals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budgeting for the program should account for the stated tuition; included services (photocopying, evening meals) remove some logistical burdens for participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial aid availability
rubrics_metrics.description: A number of half-tuition scholarships are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants with financial need may apply for limited half-tuition scholarships; availability is not guaranteed but is explicitly offered as part of program access.
